disk.label: Does each worker have a local disk for its own files?
disk.help: The worker keeps its recorder file and its cache file in storage.dir. A worker in a container with no writable disk has no such folder.

values.label: Yes
values.help: Each worker can write files to a folder of its own.

values.label: No
values.help: The worker keeps the recent events in memory only and writes no file of its own.

history.label: Where should the long event history live?
history.help: Every worker keeps its recent events in memory, two minutes by default. The long history is what the trace search reads when you ask it to search history.

values.label: Recorder files
values.help: A worker with a local disk writes recorder files. Their sealed copies in the history folder are the long history. A worker without a disk keeps no long history.

values.label: Postgres
values.help: Every worker writes its events to one table in a Postgres database, partitioned by hour and kept 6 hours by default. No disk is needed.

hosts.label: Where do the workers of one cluster run?
hosts.help: Workers on one host share one folder for their files. Workers on several hosts need a folder that every worker mounts, or a service that every worker reaches.

values.label: One host
values.help: All workers of the cluster run on the same machine.

values.label: Several hosts
values.help: The workers of the cluster run on two or more machines.

services.label: Which of these does every worker reach?
services.help: Check each one that every worker of the cluster can reach. Check nothing when there is none.

values.label: A folder that every worker mounts
values.help: The same folder at the same path on every host, for example on a network file system.

values.label: Consul
values.help: A Consul agent and its HTTP API.

registry.label: Registry
registry.help: How the workers find each other. The workers list and the cache exchange use it.

election.label: Election
election.help: Which worker runs a cluster task, the archive included, in each slot.

filesystem.label: Files in the shared folder
filesystem.explain: One card file per worker in <shared.dir>/fleet/workers/, or in <storage.dir>/fleet/workers/ when shared.dir is empty. Workers that see the same folder see each other.

none.label: None (no peers)
none.explain: No registry: each worker knows only itself.

postgres.label: Postgres
postgres.explain: One row per worker in the table fleet_workers of the schema of the connection. The age of a card comes from the clock of the database server.

redis.label: Redis
redis.explain: One key per worker and an index of the workers, under the key prefix of the connection. The age of a card comes from the clock of the Redis server.

consul.label: Consul
consul.explain: One key per worker under the key prefix of the connection, held by a session of the worker. A worker is online while its key has a session.

filesystem.label: Lock files in the shared folder
filesystem.explain: One lock file per cluster task in <shared.dir>/tasks/<cluster>/, or under storage.dir when shared.dir is empty. Only the workers that see the same folder take part in one election.

postgres.label: Postgres
postgres.explain: One row per cluster task in the table task_locks of the schema of the connection.

redis.label: Redis
redis.explain: One key per cluster task under the key prefix of the connection.

consul.label: Consul
consul.explain: One key per cluster task under the key prefix of the connection, held by a session.

postgres.explain: The Postgres database of the providers and of the recorder history. At the first start the worker creates the schema drakkar and the tables it uses.

env.name: DK_CONNECTIONS__POSTGRES__MAIN__DSN
env.explain: The Postgres connection string, with the user and the password. The config does not load while this variable is not set.

redis.explain: The Redis server of the providers. Every key of the providers starts with drakkar:.

env.name: DK_CONNECTIONS__REDIS__MAIN__URL
env.explain: The whole Redis URL, with the password when the server needs one. When this variable is not set, the worker uses redis://localhost:6379/0.

consul.explain: The Consul agent of the providers. Change the address to the agent that your workers reach.

env.name: DK_CONNECTIONS__CONSUL__MAIN__TOKEN
env.explain: The Consul ACL token. Leave it unset when the agent needs none.

folder.explain: Change the path to where every worker mounts the folder. The registry cards, the sealed history and the archives go there.

notes.text: Without a shared folder or a service, each host elects its own worker. A cluster task runs once per host, not once per cluster.

Without a shared folder, the archive pass reads only the history folder of the host that holds the lease. The sealed files of the other hosts are never archived. So this config turns the archive off with history.archive.enabled: false, and nothing deletes the sealed files. Add a folder that every worker mounts to keep the archive on.
With an empty storage.dir the recorder runs with persistence none. Each worker keeps the recent events in memory only, two minutes by default, and has no cache file. Nothing is sealed or archived.

Every worker writes its events to the table drakkar.recorder_events. The table has one partition per hour and keeps 6 hours. One busy worker writes about 9 GB per hour, so size the database before you start. The role in the DSN must own the table. The trace search then reads the history of its own cluster from this table, not from sealed files.

With no local disk and no shared folder, the filesystem election has no folder for its lock files. A worker that declares a cluster task does not start. Declare no cluster task, or add a shared folder or a service for the election.
With no registry, the workers list shows only the current worker, and the cache exchange pulls nothing.
The registry needs the UI server. Keep ui.enabled: true, the default.

examples.name: defaults
examples.yaml:
sources:
  kafka:
    enabled: true
    max_poll_records: 60
    session_timeout_ms: 10000
    heartbeat_interval_ms: 2000
    max_poll_interval_ms: 360000
executor:
  max_executors: 6
  window_size: 6
  task_timeout_seconds: 30
  max_retries: 2
  drain_timeout_seconds: 30
  backpressure_high_multiplier: 16
  backpressure_low_multiplier: 4
ui:
  ws_min_duration_ms: 0
  log_min_duration_ms: 0
  recorder:
    event_min_duration_ms: 0
    output_min_duration_ms: 0
    store_output: true
fleet:
  registry:
    provider: filesystem
periodic:
  election:
    provider: filesystem
